info.name: Promotion service: reviewer walkthrough
info.description: Run folders in order against MODE=demo. Every fixture creates an isolated campaign. User actions use realistic authenticated MAX webhooks, then poll the durable outbox. No external MAX account is required. Only demo credentials are included. The daily draw may already be drawn by the scheduler; /run returns its saved result. Use the Collection Runner or Postman CLI with local.postman_environment.json. Expected duration: under one minute.
